name: Shemaiah
overview: Shemaiah is a male member of the tribe of Levi, distinguished as a descendant of Jeduthun. His identity is primarily noted through this unique genealogical connection, situating him within the Levitical lineage. There are no additional personal notes recorded about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Shemaiah means 'y-h-v-h hears,' reflecting a theophoric element that emphasizes God’s attentiveness. This proper name is recorded in 2 Chronicles 29:13 and does not indicate that it was given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Shemaiah as a descendant of Jeduthun, linking him to a notable Levitical family. Beyond this, no further family relationships are documented.
scriptureSignificance: Shemaiah’s significance lies in his Levitical heritage as a descendant of Jeduthun, which connects him to the priestly and musical duties in the temple worship system. This connection underscores the continuity of God’s ordained worship through the tribe of Levi, reflecting the faithfulness of God’s people in honoring Him. His mention in 2 Chronicles 29:13 situates him within the restoration efforts during King Hezekiah’s reign, highlighting the importance of faithful service in God’s house.
